lines.en: : Yo.
: Figured I’d come say hi since you’ve been all by yourself this whole time.
: Sana?
: Oh...yeah. Sorry. I just...
: I wasn’t expecting you, I guess.
: I figured you’d be staying with Ayane until it came time for us to leave.
: And I figured you would have joined us at some point, but...here we are.
: Here we are...
: Is this really how you wanted to spend your day? Alone under a tree while Ayane and I hung out without you?
: It beats getting killed by the sun, at least.
: Besides, I’d just be getting in the way if I came and joined you two. Even if...it was supposed to just be Ayane and me today.
: Uh-oh. Did I interrupt your romantic getaway with your roommate?
: Mhm. Do you really think I’d ever wear something like this for you?
: Crazy. All this time and I had no idea you felt that way about her. Does Ayane know?
: Of course. She’s the one who invited me after all.
: But I suppose I’ll always be second to you, Sensei. If only she and I went back as far as you two. Maybe then I’d have a real chance.
: But, that aside...I’m glad the sun is finally gone. At long last, I can feel my energy returning little by little.
: Kudos to me for managing to both stay out of harm’s way and give you and Ayane all of the private time you needed.
: Kudos to you, indeed. But there’s no need to bring up Ayane anymore when it’s time for the two of us to have some “private time” now.
: And what would you like to do with that “private time” I wonder?
: That entirely depends on how much I am allowed to do.
: I don’t remember setting any guidelines or rules for you to follow.
: Maybe not directly. But you’ve inadvertently set a bunch of unspoken ones throughout the brief time we’ve known one another.
: Have I?
: You have.
: Name one.
: Remember that time you passed out because I held your hand while you weren't looking?
: Doesn’t ring a bell.
: Or all of those times you told me you only looked at me as a teacher?
: Are you something more than that?
: You tell me. I have no idea what to make of this...weird mood you’re in right now.
: Weird?...
: Yeah. Did that swimsuit unlock some sort of secret power or something? Because you’ve seemed a lot less...Sana than normal tonight.
: I’m...the same Sana as always, though.
: I guess I’m just a little excited that you decided to spend time with me...that’s all.
: That stuff about being worried about bothering you and Ayane...it’s all I could think of over here.
: I wanted to see you. I wanted to see you so badly. But you belong to her and I belong to-
: I don’t belong to anyone.
: Then...
: Why not belong to me?
: I’m sorry?
: Am I not good enough?
: Am I too small?
: Is someone like Ayane or my mom better suited to your interests?
: What’s...going on with you right now?
: Maybe I’ve been drinking? I was just saying the other day that I talk too much when I drink, wasn’t I?
: You were...but I don’t see any alcohol laying around.
: Heat stroke, then? That makes people act all sorts of weird, doesn’t it?
: It does, but...
: Why does it even matter? It’s just the two of us now...so you shouldn’t be worrying about something as silly as why I’m acting the way I am if the way I’m acting is good.
: Enjoy the moment, Sensei. We don’t get many of them.
: Though...
: I really wish we did.
: I get lonely...just like every other girl.
: There are things I want. Things I want that everyone else gets to have while I sit in the background. Unremarkable and exceedingly average.
: I don’t want to be average anymore. I want to be fun. Exciting. Someone like Ayane or...or Rin.
: People who can talk to you without getting nervous or scared or worried or-
: But that’s not you.
: What do you know about who I am?
: Only what you’ve taught me over the last...five or six semesters.
: I can teach you more, you know.
: There are tons of things about me I’m keeping locked away. And there are only so many places I can hide the key.
: You’re not going to question how we’ve been together for five or six semesters despite still being a first year?
: Oh! Uhh...has it been that many already? It feels like just yesterday we were meeting one another and-
: Who are you?
: Sana Sakakibara...part time bartender and full time student. Resident of...dorm number two. Ayane’s best friend. A...member of the light music club.
: A girl who...really likes you and...is having a really hard time accepting that?
: Oh, God damn it.
: You know, you’re a real buzzkill. A girl you’ve been chasing after to no avail for [totaldays] days is finally starting to open up to you and you go and do this?
: You...
: You’re the girl from...
: From...
: Where do I know you from?
: I’m surprised you know me at all. Those memories aren’t supposed to stick.
: What memories? How do you know what is and isn’t supposed to stick? And how were you Sana just now?
: So many questions. You must be really confused, huh?
: Can you blame me? It’s not every day someone I know transforms into someone else.
: Hey, hey, hey! How can you be so sure of that? That Ami girl is really suspicious at times, isn’t she?
: And what about Niki? A convenient childhood friend slash ex-girlfriend who’s also an idol that never gave up on you after all of those years away? Get real.
: There’s tons of weird stuff that happens to you.
: If I were you and I were going to go hunting for shapeshifters, those two are where I would start. Not the short, quiet girl with unsightly habits.
: Unsightly habits? What are-
: But enough about that! Let’s talk about my amazing impression and how awesome I am!
: Hooray! Clap clap clap clap clap.
: I don’t want it to sound like I’m encouraging this since I’d prefer if you stayed out of my students’ bodies, but...you should probably talk a little slower the next time you slip into Sana’s.
: First off, rude.
: Second, I didn’t slip into anyone’s body. I’ve been me the whole time.
: You saw Sana because that’s what you wanted to see. And you stopped seeing her the moment you realized you were never seeing her at all.
: The human mind is interesting...how it can be tricked into seeing or feeling certain things that aren’t there.
: But I guess that maybe I do take a little advantage of that from time to time.
: It’s not every day that I get to talk to somebody, you know. Gotta seize the opportunity when the opportunity arises.
: Can you tell me...literally anything of value? Who you are? Why you’re here? Where Sana is?
: Sana’s just a little further down the shoreline. Good luck trying to talk to her right now, though.
: As for the other two questions...I’m sorry, but I can’t answer them.
: Why not?
: Because I can’t.
: That’s not a very good answer.
: Hey, I don’t make the rules. In fact, I rarely ever even follow them. Which I guess inadvertently answers question numero dos but, in case anyone asks, that was totally off the record.
: Any vague hints pertaining to who you are?
: Wanna take a guess?
: Are you...
: Woohoo! You got it-
: Completely and utterly wrong. Not even close. 0/10.
: Well, then...do you have anything to do with the weird shit going on in this world? Assuming you know about the weird shit going on in this world, that is.
: Again, that’s not really something I can answer. But you’ve gotta say, it’d be pretty gosh darn weird if I wasn’t somehow involved, right?
: Showing up out of nowhere...passing as a mimic...I wager I’m probably the most suspicious person you’ve ever met.
: I wouldn’t say you passed, by the way. Your impression was still miles off.
: But I guess expecting anyone to be able to understand Sana without putting in the effort to actually get to know her is just...not likely.
: Are you insinuating something there, buddy?
: Just that it’s a little rude to make up someone’s feelings.
: I wasn’t making them up. I was just...
: ...Appropriating them?
: Channeling her energy?
: Are you a psychic now, too?
: Nope! And I’m very thankful for that as the idea of being able to read your mind gives me the heebie-jeebies.
: I am also thankful that you can’t read my mind right about now.
: Keep it in your pants, chief. I’m not that kind of character.
: Even though you were only a step or two away from seducing me using Sana’s appearance?
: Hey, I obviously would have backed down before it went anywhere. I just wanted to see how long I could mess with you before you snapped out of it.
: Snapped out of what, exactly?
: Another one of your thingamajigs.
: You walked off to find Sana and, somewhere along the way, your mind went blank.
: Thankfully, I was close by when it happened.  So I got to see the whole thing.
: I’m...blacking out right now?
: Mmm...not quite. In fact, I’m not really sure what’s going on- what with you vaguely remembering me and being able to hold an actual conversation in your current state.
: Maybe you’re just getting a little better at being crazy?
: Wow. What a fun and useful skill to have.
: Yeah. Not many practical uses for that, are there?
: Why can’t I transform into other people? I want that instead.
: You can!
: You just do it in a different way than me.
: Think of how many yous there are. How many yous there have been. Each one entirely different from the last.
: And think of how many yous there could be at this current moment! Grooming teenage girls in parallel universes...plunging life itself into a lecherous, endless bout of chaos!
: There are just so many possibilities!
: And yet you have found yourself in this timeline...where everything is bad and good all at once.
: Where time moves both backward and forward simultaneously...just like Ayane said.
: If that was even her speaking. I’m not sure who I can trust anymore knowing that you can just...become other people.
: Thankfully, that’s a worry you won’t have to live with for long since you will probably forget me again after tonight.
: I’ll never turn into her, though.
: And I know it’s pointless to say this since I literally just told you you're going to forget, but...try and remember that.
: Why won't you turn into Ayane?
: Don’t wanna.
: Don’t like feeling what she feels.
: Also, don’t make it sound like doing what I did tonight is some sort of hobby for me. I normally just try on their clothes. Very rarely do I feel the need to step in and start playing charades.
: Maybe...don’t do that at all anymore.
: Going to have a hard time looking at Sana now that you know how she really feels about you? Or is that something you’ve known all along?
: I won’t know anything for sure until she tells me. Hearing her feelings fall out of someone else’s throat just isn’t enough.
: But you have your suspicions, of course.
: Of course.
: Everyone loves me.
: They have to.
: Do they?
: The world was made for me.
: Was it?
: Yes.
: Is that what you really believe? Or is that what you want to believe?
: It’s the only thing that makes sense.
: You talk to birds. You are no authority on what does and doesn’t make sense.
: Are you?
: No.
: In many respects, I’m just as lost as you are.
: I just got a little lucky and skipped living through the whole “infinite high school” thing.
: You get used to it. I’m not really complaining.
: Why would you? Your life is great.
: And yours isn’t?
: It will be.
: Some day.
: I hope that day comes soon.
: You’re kind of annoying and I feel like you can definitely tell me more than what you actually have, but...
: I don’t hate you or anything.
: I’m glad.
: I don’t hate you either.
: I think we have to say goodbye now.
: I see...
: I’m not going to remember you...right?
: Probably not.
: Then, for the sake of ending this extremely weird conversation on a good note...can you tell me your name?
: Why don’t you give me one?
: Give you one?
: I have no idea where I’d even start.
: I don’t know anything about you other than the fact that you have nice eyes and...occasionally  someone else’s eyes instead.
: Would you like a suggestion?
: It would certainly be appreciated.
: Then...
: Name me after your favorite flower.
